name: How do I know if my home needs a foundation retrofit?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my home needs a foundation retrofit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homes built before 1979 in California are often good candidates for foundation retrofitting, especially if they are on a raised foundation with cripple walls. Signs like an unbolted foundation, unbraced cripple walls, or living in an earthquake-prone area indicate a potential need. A professional inspection by a structural engineer or a qualified foundation retrofit contractor can assess your home's specific vulnerabilities and determine if a retrofit is recommended to enhance its seismic resilience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Homes built before 1979 or those with unbolted foundations and unbraced cripple walls often need retrofitting. A professional inspection confirms the need.
